## Part 6: Choose Your Census Variables for Mapping and Download Them

### Map 1: Kids aged 6-11 in Poverty

```{r}
vars_acs5 |>
  filter(str_detect(str_to_lower(concept), "poverty status in the past 12 months by age")) |>
  select(name, label, concept)
```

```{r}
options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)
nc_kids_below_poverty <- get_acs(geography = "county",
                              variables=c(poverty_kids="B17020_004"),
                              state="NC",
                              geometry=TRUE)

nc_kids_above_poverty <- get_acs(geography = "county",
                   variables=c(non_poverty_kids="B17020_012"),
                   state="NC",
                   geometry=FALSE)

```

```{r}
combined_kids <- left_join(nc_kids_below_poverty,nc_kids_above_poverty, by="GEOID")
```

```{r}
combined_kids <- combined_kids |> 
  mutate(total_kids = estimate.x+estimate.y,
         pct_kids_poverty=estimate.x/total_kids*100)

combined_kids <- st_transform(combined_kids, "EPSG:32119")
```

```{r}
# kids 6-11 in poverty
map1 <-
  tm_shape(combined_kids)+
  tm_polygons(fill = "pct_kids_poverty",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(n = 5, style = "jenks"),
              fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Kids in Poverty (%)"))+
  tm_title("Percent of Kids in Poverty (Age 6-11)")+
  tm_credits("Author: Arnav Pandey\nData Source: US Census Bureau",
             position = c("left", "bottom"))+
  tm_layout(frame=FALSE,
            frame.legend=TRUE,
            legend.position = tm_pos_out("right", "center"))
```

```{r}
map1
```

### Map 2: Households in Poverty

```{r}
vars_acs5 |>
  filter(str_detect(str_to_lower(concept), "poverty status in the past 12 months by household")) |>
  select(name, label, concept)
```

```{r}
options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)
nc_households_below_poverty <- get_acs(geography = "county",
                                 variables=c(poverty_homes="B17017_003"),
                                 state="NC",
                                 geometry=TRUE)

nc_households_above_poverty <- get_acs(geography = "county",
                                       variables=c(poverty_homes="B17017_032"),
                                       state="NC",
                                       geometry=FALSE)
```

```{r}
combined_households <- 
  left_join(nc_households_below_poverty,nc_households_above_poverty, by= "GEOID")
```

```{r}
combined_households <- combined_households|>
  mutate(total_households=estimate.x+estimate.y,
         pct_households_poverty=estimate.x/total_households*100)
combined_households <- st_transform(combined_households, "EPSG:32119")
```

```{r}
map2 <- 
  tm_shape(combined_households)+
  tm_polygons(fill = "pct_households_poverty",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(n = 5, style = "jenks", values="Purples"),
              fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Households in Poverty (%)"))+
  tm_title("Percent of Family Households in Poverty")+
  tm_credits("Author: Arnav Pandey\nData Source: US Census Bureau",
             position = c("left", "bottom"))+
  tm_layout(frame=FALSE,
            frame.legend=TRUE,
            legend.position = tm_pos_out("right", "center"))
```

### Map 4: Combination Map

```{r}
comboSNAP <- st_join(combined_SNAP,combined_households)

comboSNAP <- comboSNAP |>
```


## Part 7: Combined Arrangement

```{r}
tmap_arrange(map1,map2,map3,map4,nrow=2,ncol=2)
```

```{r}
mean_center <- function(x, y, w = rep(1, length(x))) {
  tibble(x = sum(x * w) / sum(w),
         y = sum(y*w)/sum(w))
}

standard_distance <- function(x, y, w = rep(1, length(x))) {
  center <- mean_center(x, y, w)
  sqrt(sum(w * ((x - center$x)^2 + (y - center$y)^2)) / sum(w))
}
```

```{r}
combined_kids_xy <- combined_kids |>
  st_centroid()|>
  st_coordinates()

combined_kids <- combined_kids |>
  mutate(x = combined_kids_xy[, "X"],
         y = combined_kids_xy[, "Y"])

sd <- standard_distance(combined_kids$x, combined_kids$y)

center <- mean_center(combined_kids$x,combined_kids$y,w=combined_kids$estimate.x)

poverty_center <- st_as_sf(center,coords=c("x","y"),crs=st_crs(combined_kids))
poverty_circle <- st_buffer(poverty_center,sd)
poverty_circle <- poverty_circle |>
  mutate(Type="Center of Child Poverty")
```

```{r}
map5 <- 
  tm_shape(comboSNAP)+
  tm_polygons(fill = "snapGap",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(n = 5, style = "jenks", values="spectral"),
              fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Impoverished Households\n Recieving SNAP (%)"))+
  tm_credits("Author: Arnav Pandey\nData Source: US Census Bureau",
             position = c("left", "bottom"))+
  tm_layout(frame=FALSE,
            frame.legend=TRUE,
            legend.position = tm_pos_out("right", "center"))+
  tm_shape(poverty_circle)+
  tm_polygons(fill ="Type",
              col="black",
              lwd=1,
              fill_alpha=0.1,
              fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "Weighted Center"))+
  tm_title("SNAP Coverage Relative to\n Child Poverty (Ages 6-11)")
```

```{r}
map5
```
